snippet.title: Heart of the Forest - Reveal Trailer | An Interactive FMV Horror
snippet.description:
Heart of the Forest is an interactive psychological horror, inspired by centuries-old supernatural tales from Germany’s Black Forest. Coming to PC, PS5, Xbox Series and Switch in Q1 2026. 

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274320/Heart_of_the_Forest/

What begins as a scenic escape quickly unravels into something far more sinister. When their guide disappears, the group realises they are hopelessly lost—and not alone. Strange events blur the line between reality and nightmare, as a dark force takes hold and draws them deeper into its grasp.

Haunted by fear, trauma, and secrets of the past, each character is pushed to their breaking point, and their survival depends on your choices.
